entries.01d76a0e0b81c0b3: This business produces color filters for displays, antireflection films, photomasks (circuit masters for semiconductors), and semiconductor package substrates. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥185,875 million, a 34.3% decrease from the previous year. In semiconductor-related products, FC-BGA substrates obtained several certifications for advanced products and demand for communications applications increased, but revenue decreased due to the effect of shifting Tekscend Photomask Corporation to an equity-method affiliate. The company explains that excluding this effect, revenue would have increased. In display-related products, revenue also decreased, due to inventory optimization at customers of antireflection films and the effect of shifting Giantplus Technology Co.,Ltd. to an equity-method affiliate.
entries.1547986ac09874f4: The holding company of a group that, building on printing technology, handles everything from information services and packaging materials to semiconductor components.
entries.2848c39369656123: This field produces color filters for displays, antireflection films, small and medium TFT liquid-crystal panels, and light-control films, among others. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue decreased due to inventory optimization at customers of antireflection films and the effect of shifting Giantplus Technology Co.,Ltd. to an equity-method affiliate.
entries.436a397b120c6674: Catalogs and Other Advertising Printed Materials
entries.481f6d16a1bbdc1f: This business produces securities, cards, business forms, and printed materials such as catalogs, books and magazines, and also handles BPO services that carry out operations on behalf of companies and government bodies, as well as digital sales support. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥903,930 million, the largest of the three reportable segments, up 1.0% year on year. In digital business-related operations, marketing DX increased, and revenue rose, also helped by the expansion of the government ID business and the effects of acquisitions. On the other hand, BPO-related revenue declined due to the reaction to one-time projects in the previous year, and communication media-related revenue declined as publishing and commercial printing decreased. The publishing and printing business has been consolidated into TOPPAN Chlore Co., Ltd.
entries.4be0e8af379d8778: This field produces flexible packaging materials, paper containers, liquid composite containers, plastic molded products, contract and entrusted filling, transparent barrier films, and exterior materials for lithium-ion secondary batteries, among others. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, packaging for food and other uses grew overseas, the new plant in Czechia began full-scale operation and sales of the monomaterial transparent barrier film “GL BARRIER” expanded, and the flexible packaging business of SONOCO PRODUCTS COMPANY and the acquisition effect of Irplast S.p.A. also contributed, so revenue increased. Domestically, SX packaging using films made with recycled materials spread under the sustainable brand “SMARTS.”
entries.61ebf876c826ed08: This field produces decorative sheets, flooring, decorative panels, exterior building materials, and noncombustible products, among others. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, sales of decorative sheets expanded in Europe and the Americas and new markets in emerging economies were developed overseas, and in Japan environmentally friendly decorative sheets and the space production brand “expace” spread, so revenue increased. To expand its space production business, the company acquired Arowāzu Co., Ltd., which has a track record in office design and construction, in January 2026.
entries.73620ca84f430fb6: This field produces securities in general, data print services, IC cards, IC tags, anti-counterfeiting devices, and others. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, data print services and others increased, and revenue rose.
entries.7fa73ee34e928b8b: Decorative Sheets, Wallpaper and Other Building Materials
entries.8aed5b4d6582e525: This field produces photomasks and FC-BGA substrates, which are high-density package substrates on which semiconductor chips are mounted. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, FC-BGA substrates obtained several certifications for advanced products, and demand for communications applications increased. At the Ishikawa Plant, the company is advancing the launch of a pilot line for next-generation semiconductor packages, and at the Niigata Plant a new production line for high-end products has started operation. It also participates in the Japan-US mixed consortium “US-JOINT.” On the other hand, because Tekscend Photomask Corporation was shifted to an equity-method affiliate, revenue decreased for the business as a whole, but excluding this effect, revenue increased.

entries.a4d07f95177b273e: This field undertakes back-office operations and customer contact services, among other tasks. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, although it won projects mainly in the finance and government fields, revenue declined due to the reaction to one-time projects in the previous year.
entries.a888bfcb771308bd: This field covers ink manufacturing and similar activities and is handled by artience Co., Ltd. The filing does not print a description of performance for each field, and the direction of change cannot be read from it.
entries.a911e0f03b3d0264: This field handles gift card ASP services, RFID solutions, payment-related services, e-books, digital marketing services, digital content production, application development, and others. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, marketing DX, which promotes business transformation support tailored to customers' industry characteristics, increased, and in the secure business, the government ID business, including in Global South countries such as those in Africa, expanded. Also helped by the effects of the acquisitions of the civil ID business unit of Nordic company HID in January 2025 and of Thai company DZ Card, revenue rose.
entries.aac6f2281a3e202b: This business produces flexible packaging materials, paper containers and liquid containers that wrap food and daily necessities, building materials such as decorative sheets used for floors and walls of homes, and ink. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥715,227 million, up sharply by 32.0% year on year. In packaging-related operations, as the EU's Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation (PPWR) took effect in February 2025 and the switch to environmentally friendly packaging materials accelerated in earnest, the new plant in the Czech Republic began full-scale operation, and sales of the transparent barrier film 'GL BARRIER' expanded. Also helped by the effects of the acquisitions of the flexible packaging business of SONOCO PRODUCTS COMPANY and Irplast S.p.A., revenue rose. Building materials-related revenue also rose, due to expanded sales of decorative sheets in Europe and the United States, among other factors.

entries.df75b335923309cd: This field produces business forms, books, magazines, textbooks, catalogs, brochures, and SP tools such as POP, and also plans and runs promotions and events. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, publishing and commercial printing declined, and revenue fell. The publishing and printing business has been consolidated into TOPPAN Chlore Co., Ltd. to improve profitability, and in business forms, the company is advancing structural reforms, including reorganization of its sites.
